title: PRD: Lighthouse endpoint bundle (chat + completions + embeddings + rerank) - launch & acceptance rundown
creator: Sophie Park
description:
Summary: This PRD covers the ‘Lighthouse’ compact endpoint bundle: a curated, opinionated hosted API package that exposes Chat, Completions, Embeddings, and Rerank from a single product-ready surface. The goal is a low-friction, high-signal bundle for customers who want consistent performance and predictable cost without assembling multiple endpoints.

Goals:
- Launch a single discoverable product SKU that maps to four capability routes (chat, completion, embeddings, rerank) with unified pricing and SLA documentation.
- Provide airtight acceptance criteria and a deterministic rollout path (canary -> regional gradual -> global).
- Ship API contract docs, SDK examples, and a Console tile with quickstart that highlights performance targets and cost guidance.

Non-goals:
- Do not include multimodal inputs in v1.
- Do not add per-tenant on-prem packaging for this launch (Private will be follow-up).

Scope in v1:
- API surface: /v1/lighthouse/chat, /v1/lighthouse/completions, /v1/lighthouse/embeddings, /v1/lighthouse/rerank.
- Behavioral contracts: deterministic temperature/stop token handling, streaming behavior for chat and completions, consistent embedding vector format (float32 baseline then quantized variant), and rerank API that returns scoring and explanation tokens.
- Runtime targets: p50 latency <= 120ms for embeddings (cold), p95 <= 450ms for chat baseline (short prompts), token throughput targets documented per model tier.
- Observability: route-level latency, token-usage cost breakdown, prefix cache hit rate, rollout traffic fractions, and regression test harness results.

Out of scope / deferred:
- Advanced rerank explainability UI (post-launch).
- Automated model-switching by quality observed (manual fallback only).

User stories:
- As an app engineer, I can call /v1/lighthouse/chat with streaming to power an in-app assistant with predictable latency and cost.
- As an analytics engineer, I can view per-route token breakdowns to reconcile billing and debug regressions.
- As an SRE, I can configure canary traffic weights and fall back to a defined secondary model variant under capacity pressure.

API contract summary (developer-facing):
- Chat: streaming WebSocket and HTTP chunked pipeline, message array input, conversation_id optional for KV cache.
- Completions: single prompt or prompt-template with max_tokens and stop sequences, supports sampling controls.
- Embeddings: synchronous batch endpoint, accepts list of strings up to 5k tokens total per request. Returns vectors with 'vector' field and 'model' field.
- Rerank: takes query + candidate list (up to 512 candidates), returns rank order, score, and optional token-level justification (flagged by explain=true).

Performance / SLOs and safety constraints:
- SLA: 99.5% successful responses for paid tier with documented latency SLO bands by model.
- Cost guidance: provide recommended batching and cache TTL defaults to hit median RU (request units) targets.
- Safety: content filtering must run pre-send for chat/completions; embeds and rerank must be labeled in telemetry when content-filter triggers.

Rollout strategy:
- Stage 1 (Canary): 2% traffic to GA customers with feature flag; internal beta accounts + early partners.
- Stage 2 (Regional ramp): 10% regional traffic increase every 48 hours with rollback checks.
- Stage 3 (Global): Full launch after 7 days of stable telemetry and zero severe incidents.

Migration / Compatibility:
- Maintain existing chat/completions/embeddings/rerank endpoints; Lighthouse is additive. Offer migration guide with SDK snippets and cost comparison.

Monitoring & runbook:
- Dashboards: lighthouse-route-latency, prefix-cache-hit, token-cost-delta, rerank-error-rate.
- Alerts: p95 latency exceeding SLO for 15m, error rate >2% sustained 10m, cache-thrashing indicator.
- Rollback criteria: sustained error rate >3% for 30m or business-critical customer-reported failures unresolved in 60m.

Deliverables:
- API spec (OpenAPI) and SDK examples (Node, Python).
- Console tile and quickstart guide.
- Launch blog + docs.

Decision log (brief):
- Chose separate /lighthouse/* routes rather than query param to keep tracing and telemetry simple (decision 2025-02-20).
- Embedding vector format will default to float32 in v1; quantized variant flagged as alpha (decision 2025-02-25).
acceptance_criteria: API: All four routes respond with documented contract for a canonical test harness (automated tests pass in CI).
Performance: Internal benchmark suite shows median latency within 10% of target for 95% of synthetic traces across regional hardware types.
Observability: Console tile surfaces per-route token breakdowns, and dashboards for latency, errors, and prefix cache hit rate are linked from the tile.
Rollout controls: Feature flag and canary routing implemented; infra can shift traffic weights with sub-minute propagation.
Docs: OpenAPI published, SDK examples in JS/Python included in docs, migration guide present with cost comparison examples.
Security: Security review complete and KMS integration verification on logs/metrics for PII-sensitive fields; result uploaded to Confluence.
Safety: Pre-send content filtering integrated and end-to-end tests demonstrate filter firing and labeling in telemetry.
Customer experience: No high-severity regressions in partner beta (0 P0 / P1 outages) for the 7-day canary window.

outcome_metrics: Adoption: % of new signups using Lighthouse within 30 days
Latency: p95 latency per route vs SLO
Cost efficiency: tokens-per-dollar delta for Lighthouse vs equivalent calls across separate endpoints
Reliability: error rate and incidents during first 30 days
Revenue: conversion rate of trials to paid for users who used Lighthouse in trial

notes: This ticket intentionally prioritizes a compact, opinionated UX versus maximum configurability. Post-launch roadmap items include per-tenant quantization profiles, automatic model-quality-driven routing, and a richer rerank explainability surface.
release_notes_snippet: Lighthouse: a compact hosted endpoint bundle (chat, completions, embeddings, rerank) that simplifies integration and provides predictable performance and cost. GA planned after canary and regional ramp in March 2025.
